# RB-19 Data repair

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | A wrong answer, label, target, assignment or venue reported by a manager                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| First checks                  | Identify the row by venue, kind and time from the app, not by editing tables. Check whether the app has a path for the correction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Steps                         | Use the app's own path: a staff member reports a change to a current answer and the confirmer decides; labels are corrected in admin labels; a target is changed by a manager or an admin correction; a person moves venue from Staff; a wrong check is rechecked. Every one keeps history. When no path exists, stop: a fix is a reviewed function or forward migration, rehearsed on an owned stack, signed off by the owner. Never update or delete application rows by hand, bypass RLS or Storage policies, or delete a row without its object lifecycle. |
| Narrowest switch              | Remove the affected question from the venue's working list (SW-01) while the repair waits                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Switches in the catalogue     | SW-01 (Knowledge working list (per venue and question))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Data implications             | The correction is a new event or revision; the earlier value stays in history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Pending delivery              | No consumer delivery is involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Readback that proves recovery | The screen shows the corrected value, and its history shows both the earlier value and the correction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Checks without a database

- unit: `tests/unit/ops-runbooks.test.ts`: No runbook step tells an operator to update, delete or truncate application rows by hand

## Drill

- Description: On an owned stack: correct a fixture answer through a reported change and a decision, a fixture target through an admin correction, and a fixture label; each history keeps both values.
- Readiness: ready_on_main
- Status: queued
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-19/`
